fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Today through Friday... Cooler and drier on Monday with limited shower coverage. Mountains should see an uptick in showers Tuesday into Wednesday, with potential for isolated activity over the lower elevations as well. Wetting rains will generally remain quite localized through the period. Temperatures will trend warmer after Monday, but light winds and relatively elevated humidity l
